lines.en: I move slowly, and so does the tide.

lines.zh: 每一步都像从海底拔出来
lines.en: Each step feels pulled from the seabed.
Wooden doors are paper before me.
I'm no longer that person.
Bone and scale shift under my skin.
I drag my wet, heavy steps.
The tide of the witching hour runs in my veins.
The water I tread leaves black marks.
Scales scrape the ground as I pass.
I don't rush; the road waits for me.

lines.zh: 我站着，周围的声音都低了
lines.en: When I stand, all sound lowers.
Four hundred and five points; I can carry it.
The aria doesn't end, and neither do I.
Seaborn bow to me in the distance.

lines.zh: 我抬手，指节已经不像人
lines.en: I raise a hand whose knuckles are no longer human.

lines.zh: 我在听一种很低的调子
lines.en: I listen to a very low melody.

lines.zh: 铁傀儡的脚步声，我认得
lines.en: I know an iron golem's footsteps.
This body keeps changing.

lines.zh: 我还能想起自己的名字
lines.en: I can still recall my own name.
Sea wind passes through my back.
I needn't breathe, yet I can.
Nine points of armor, all under the skin.
I count the tide's beats.
A snow golem stirs beyond.
Standing here is itself a declaration.
That isn't singing; it's the sea speaking.
Do you hear it, that aria?

lines.zh: 我不是猎人，我是别的东西
lines.en: I'm not a hunter; I'm something else.
Your bones are resonating.
I've watched you a long while.

lines.zh: 三十六格之内，没有秘密
lines.en: Within thirty-six blocks, there are no secrets.
What you fear isn't me, but the sea.
Do you still recognize this face?

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我身上的潮会沾到你
lines.en: Not too close; my tide clings.
Do you still have a name?
If I wave, you should retreat.
The deep is calling me back.
I won't chase; I'll wait.
I retreated, but not far.
The sea will mend this.
Something moves under my skin.

lines.zh: 你打中的是海嗣的部分
lines.en: You struck the seaborn part.
I didn't cry out.
What runs from me is not blood but brine.
This body remembers pain.
Would you dare again?
I'm still standing.
The aria skipped a beat.
These no longer have taste for me.
Living food is very distant now.
What I consume isn't this.
You hold it up like a torch.
I no longer need it.
Leave it for those still alive.
Seaborn don't feed on meals.
That smell reminds me of before.
You'd better take it away.
I'm not hungry; I'm merely changing.

lines.zh: 你撞上的是海里的东西
lines.en: You bumped into something from the sea.
I didn't move; you bounced.
My skin is cold.

lines.zh: 你踩进了我留下的水迹
lines.en: You stepped into the water I left.

lines.zh: 这点碰撞，我几乎没感觉
lines.en: I barely felt that impact.
At this speed I cannot check my stride.
My shoulder hits like a wave.
Bump me and your bones will ring.

lines.zh: 我身上压着整片海的重量
lines.en: The weight of the whole sea presses in me.
Don't walk pressed against me.

lines.zh: 我已经不能被称作同类
lines.en: I can no longer be called kin.
The sea needs no partner, only tide.

lines.zh: 我身上的东西，会碰到你
lines.en: What's in me would touch you.
You'd be dragged into the deep.
Stay away; that's kindness.
I'm not that hunter anymore.
The aria has no such word.
I can't even keep myself.
Don't say such things to me.
Go back, while you still live.
I bend slowly.

lines.zh: 海里的东西会自己过来
lines.en: Things from the sea come on their own.
This fragment is still alive.
I tuck it into my clothes.
There are tide marks on the ground.
I pick it up; my knuckles click.
It trembles in my hand.
This is no real find.
Keep it; the deep will want it.
I set something down.
There's an iron golem over there.
The snow is too clean; it should be soiled.

lines.zh: 我盯上了那个不会流血的东西
lines.en: I've marked the one that can't bleed.

lines.zh: 十五点一下，很慢，但很稳
lines.en: Fifteen a hit: slow, steady.
You won't feel pain, I promise.
The aria enters its second movement.
The seaborn are all watching me.
Stand still; I'll come to you.
This is all the speed I have.
But I'll keep walking.
Your shadow is moving.
It knew before you did.
This needs no technique.
I'm only bringing the sea.

lines.zh: 你吸气的节奏，已经乱了
lines.en: The rhythm of your breathing has broken.
When I come, the tide comes.
Don't run; running hastens it.
Do you hear the aria?

lines.zh: 潮水推着我，一寸寸靠近
lines.en: The tide pushes me, inch by inch, closer.
Run as you like; I keep walking.
Seaborn close in from both sides.
Water pools in my footprints.
Your legs are trembling.
No hurry; I have all the hours.
The tide is rising toward you.
The iron golem has fallen.

lines.zh: 我抬手的时候，地面会湿
lines.en: When I raise a hand, the ground dampens.

lines.zh: 我停一停，潮水替我往前走
lines.en: I pause, and the tide carries me forward.
It stopped long ago.

lines.zh: 这片地上的活物，都在我眼里
lines.en: Every living thing here is in my sight.
Behind you there is only a damp wall.
I need no breath to follow.
Mist rises off the water.
The mist is full of my things.
You've stood there a long while.

lines.zh: 这一口气，你留着自己用
lines.en: Save that breath for yourself.
The tide won't stop.
Neither will I.
I wave, and the tide presses down.
My scales slice your clothes.
Slow, but very heavy.
The seaborn move with me.
Fifteen at a time.
The tide pushes you back.
These fingers aren't human.
Bones knocking sound hollow.

lines.zh: 这不是拳，是海的一部分
lines.en: This isn't a fist; it's part of the sea.

lines.zh: 你架住了，可潮从袖口进来
lines.en: You blocked it, but the tide comes in at your cuff.

lines.zh: 我的第二击贴着地面到了
lines.en: My second blow arrives along the ground.
I'm close now.
The aria reaches its high note.

lines.zh: 水声在我背后，一直响着
lines.en: The sound of water runs on behind me.
The tide receded; I remain.
The aria rises from the seabed.

lines.zh: 这具身体比上次更不像人
lines.en: This body is less human than last time.

lines.zh: 四百零五点，我走了上来
lines.en: Four hundred and five points, walking ashore.
The seaborn part to make way.
No one needs to summon me.
Water seeps where I land.

lines.zh: 你们的海岸线，往后挪了
lines.en: Your coastline just moved back.

lines.zh: 我还能说出自己的名字
lines.en: I can still say my own name.
But it doesn't sound right.
The wind stopped; the aria continues.
The iron golem turned first.
I stand straight, a tide-worn monument.

lines.zh: 这片地上的颜色变深了
lines.en: The colors of this land deepened.

lines.zh: 我是一个不该回来的东西
lines.en: I'm something that shouldn't have come back.
The deep pushed me up.
The sand beneath darkens.
I'm here, and so is the tide.
Don't call me by that name.
It isn't mine anymore.
The flames curled my scales.
On landing, a bone slipped out of place.
I sank, then rose again.
The blast tore my skin.
Something entered between my scales.

lines.zh: 这力量让体内的海翻滚
lines.en: This power churns the sea inside me.
Hungry too long; my form is loosening.

lines.zh: 雷劈开皮，里面的东西亮了
lines.en: Lightning split my skin; what's inside glowed.

lines.zh: 我脚下没有海，也没有地
lines.en: No sea beneath me, and no ground.
